The Couch Captain campaign has finished its full run (Feb 11–15, Arizona time) and is now expired. Here's the recap:

## Couch Captain — Final Recap

**Spend:** $631.16 of the $650.00 budget
**Impressions:** 509,856
**Link clicks:** 271
**Completed contest entries ("Photo entered"):** 20

**Cost efficiency:** ~$1.24 CPM · ~$2.33 per link click · ~$31.56 per entry

### How it performed
| Ad group | Targeting / post | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks | Entries |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| US Pet Interests | US + Pet interest, explicit eligibility post | $299.75 | 183,740 | 99 | 7 |
| US Broad | US broad, humor post ("You bought the couch…") | $331.41 | 326,116 | 172 | 13 |

Mid-flight I shifted budget toward the broad/humor group after it proved roughly half the cost per entry of the pet-interest group. Both ad groups stayed active and approved throughout; the campaign ended cleanly at $18.84 under the total cap, with no overspend.

All traffic went to https://xamblepawphotos.com/couch-captain, and every completed entry was tracked to your "Photo entered" pixel. 🐾
